notes: #2 is dated to the run of Finland framställdt i teckningar (1845–52); the plate’s own issue year is not given. #6 (Reinberg, Aura harbor in winter, about 1880, color) is a good alternative P4 but shows no landmark. #3 (Reinberg panorama from the cathedral tower) is the best old general view but is two photos joined with a visible seam down the middle and dated only 1860–96. #8 (1910, from the cathedral tower) is blocked by the window bars. #10 and #12 are other frames of the same 1929 flight.
